posts.text:
in ukraine, if you want to remove a senior official, you take to the streets. 

in russia, you have to wait for a hotdog vendor-turned-warlord to launch a mutiny. even then the wait is much longer.

posts.text:
responding to widespread social protest in ukraine, zelenskyy sacks his top general, big (and welcome) turnaround after dismissing defense minister fedorov, who had engineered the turnaround in the war. 

not the sort of thing that could happen in russia.
